prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Panasonic Expandable Digital Cordless DECT 6.0 Phone System - KXTG1032S; brand: panasonic; description: Panasonic Expandable Digital Cordless DECT 6.0 Phone System - KXTG1032S/ Up To 17 Hours Of Talk Time/ Expandable Up To 6 Handsets/ Up To 3-Way Conference Capability/ Light-Up Indicator With Ringer/Message Alert/ Backlit LCD On Handset/ Digital Speakerphone/ 16-Minute All-Digital Answering System/ Si...; price: $69.00

Candidates:
1. name: Panasonic KX-TG9343T Cordless Phone; brand: Panasonic; description: Panasonic KX-TG9343T DECT 6.0 Expandable Digital Cordless Answering System w/3 Handsets; price: $102.12; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
2. name: Panasonic KX-TG9332S DECT 6.0 Expandable Digital Cordless Phone; brand: Panasonic; description: 1 x Phone Line(s) - Silver; check: model numbers differ, brand equal
3. name: Panasonic KX-TG9333T Cordless Phone - KX-TG9333T; brand: Panasonic; description: Panasonic DECT 6.0 1.9GHz Expandable Cordless Phone with Digital Answering System; check: model numbers differ, brand equal

response.text: {"reason": "The price-list item model number KXTG1032S does not match any candidate model numbers, but the brand and product type are the same for candidate 2.", "choice": "none", "confidence": 0.6}
